note: Phase B specification cases (D23): data only; each carries its inputs (the contract of docs/PHASE_B_PREREGISTRATION.md section 2) and its expected result. Conventions pinned here: a finding's class is the table's class for its code; `reason_codes` for T1 and T2 is the sorted unique set of finding codes that support the route (R1: eligible family-tagged findings; R2: the trusted failure findings; R3: eligible findings of medium or higher; R3B: eligible findings above info, possibly none; R4 and R5: the floor findings plus the eligible medium-or-higher findings of other classes), plus `evidence_conflict` for R6; null means not asserted. `needs_analyst_reason` lists reasons the result must contain. `blockers` is always the input list. `hard_evidence` is non-empty exactly for T1. Blocker codes marked in `blocker_codes` as existing are the coverage reason codes of app/coverage.py; the others are Phase B names.

content floor plus a medium finding of another class (auth) is T2 through R4
content floor plus a medium link-family finding is T2 through R4 (a structural family is a second class)
a provider score of 70 or more that does not rest on H1 to H3 is one reason class: T3 alone (D16 follow-up a)
enrichment floor plus a medium claim finding is T2 through R5
a weighted score of 36 from one reason class is T3: the band needs two classes (D22 route 3)

enrichment floor with a low second reason: T3

route R1 is unchanged: two low findings from two different families are still T2

R3B has no class condition: a score of 72 with medium-or-higher findings in only one class is still T2
